FrgtHaulingEmssnFctr.name: FrgtHaulingEmssnFctr
FrgtHaulingEmssnFctr.description: Represents the emissions factors for scope 3 freight hauling.

Ch4EmissionsFactor.description: The CH4 emissions factor associated with the freight hauling mode.

Ch4EmissionsFactorUnit.description: The unit of measure for the CH4 emissions factor.

Co2EmissionsFactor.description: The CO2 emissions factor associated with the freight hauling mode.

Co2EmissionsFactorUnit.description: The unit of measure for the CO2 emissions factor.

EmissionFactorDataSource.description: The source of the emissions factor reference data.

EmissionFactorUpdateYear.description: The year in which this reference data for the emissions factor was most recently updated.

ExternalIdentifier.description: The external identifier for the emissions factor.

FreightHaulingMode.description: The freight hauling mode that's used to calculate the emissions.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, this record might only have been referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

N2oEmissionsFactor.description: The N2O emissions factor associated with the freight hauling mode.

N2oEmissionsFactorUnit.description: The unit of measure for the N2O emissions factor.

OtherEmssnFctrId.description: The other emission factor set record containing global warming potential values for CH4 and N2O.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the user who owns this record.

ReferenceDataLoadLogId.description: The reference data load log record that's associated with the emissions factor.

ShouldLockDtastUpdtForRec.description: Indicates whether the emissions factor record can be locked from dataset updates.
